item: The events behind the instant: a durable storage-events journal (write-gate holds, guard engagements, checkpoints, store opens, pool timeouts) and its Diagnostics member
key_paths: src/monitoring/storage_events.py; src/database/writer.py; src/scheduler/storage_guard.py; src/scheduler/hygiene.py; src/database/pool_reserve.py; src/database/connect.py; src/backup/stream_backup.py; src/api/unlock.py; src/api/main.py; src/monitoring/storage.py; src/api/diagnostics_slots.py; tests/test_storage_events.py; tests/test_init_steps.py
summary: src/monitoring/storage_events.py keeps data/storage_events.json and the zip's storage-events.json (area database, owner WAL, 80,000 bytes measured at full retention): the last 20 write-gate holds of 30 s or more and the last 10 each of storage-guard engagements, checkpoints of the live store (plus a second list of the notable ones), store opens with their phases and slowest init_db steps, and pool checkout timeouts, each kind with its running total and dropped count across restarts. A cap limits what is kept, never what is counted; strings are scrubbed and cut, exceptions are recorded by class and errno name; a recording is a dict update under a short lock and does no disk I/O, the file is written by a background thread from a copy taken under the lock and written outside it (at most once a second, atomically, no fsync), a failed write is counted by class, a writer that dies is counted once and replaced by the next change, and the clean stop flushes (lifespan and atexit). storage_composition now calls the freelist freelist_bytes (it was free_bytes, read as the drive) and gains drive_free_bytes, drive_total_bytes, reserve_bytes and filesystem; contention.json's write-gate section gains pool_config and by_holder. The two lows of the 1372 check ride along (a comment, an AST guard keyed by owner and name with five mutants). 68 tests in tests/test_storage_events.py incl. the budget pin, the planted-marker tests, a write that fails (ENOSPC) under the real gate, guard, checkpoint and pool, and recordings that run while the write or the first read is stuck.
